SELECT count(DISTINCT (product_seq)) as product_num, count(DISTINCT (created_by)) as submit_user_num FROM micro_work_submit WHERE submit_type = '1' and submit_day BETWEEN #{startDate} and #{endDate}

SELECT mws.product_seq as productSeq, mp.product_name as productName, mp.product_code as productCode, IFNULL(sum(mws.check_ng_num), 0) as totalNgNum, mp.unit as productUnit FROM micro_work_submit mws INNER JOIN micro_product mp on mws.product_seq = mp.product_seq and mws.tenant_code = mp.tenant_code
mws.submit_type = '1' and mws.submit_status = 0 and mws.check_ng_num > 0
and (mp.product_code like concat('%', #{productNameOrCode}, '%') or mp.product_name like concat('%', #{productNameOrCode}, '%'))
and #{startDate} <= DATE_FORMAT(mws.submit_day, '%Y-%m-%d') and #{endDate} >= DATE_FORMAT(mws.submit_day, '%Y-%m-%d')
GROUP BY productSeq ORDER BY totalNgNum desc

mws.submit_type = '1' and mws.submit_status = 0 and mws.check_ng_num > 0

SELECT a.product_seq AS productSeq, a.product_name AS productName, a.product_code AS productCode, a.unit AS productUnit, sum(a.ng_num) as totalNgNum FROM ( SELECT mp.product_seq, mp.product_name, mp.product_code, mp.unit, mps.process_seq, mps.ng_num FROM micro_process_storage mps INNER JOIN micro_product mp ON mps.product_seq = mp.product_seq AND mps.tenant_code = mp.tenant_code

SELECT mp.product_seq as productSeq, mps.process_seq as processSeq, mp.product_name as productName, mp.product_code as productCode, mpc.process_name as processName, mps.ng_num as ngNum FROM micro_process_storage mps INNER JOIN micro_product mp on mps.product_seq = mp.product_seq and mps.tenant_code = mp.tenant_code INNER JOIN micro_process_common mpc on mps.process_seq = mpc.process_seq and mps.tenant_code = mpc.tenant_code WHERE mps.ng_num != 0 ORDER BY mps.ng_num DESC

SELECT b.product_code as productCode, b.product_name as productName, b.product_seq as productSeq, IFNULL(sum(b.total_pass_num ), 0) + IFNULL(sum(b.total_ng_num), 0) as totalNums FROM ( SELECT mws.product_seq, mp.product_name, mp.product_code, IFNULL(sum(pass_num), 0) as total_pass_num, IFNULL(sum(ng_num),0) as total_ng_num FROM micro_work_submit mws INNER JOIN micro_product mp on mws.product_seq = mp.product_seq and mws.tenant_code = mp.tenant_code INNER JOIN micro_user mu on mu.id = mws.submit_user
submit_type = '1' and submit_status in (1, 2)
and (mp.product_code like concat('%', #{productNameOrCode}, '%') or mp.product_name like concat( '%', #{productNameOrCode}, '%'))
and mu.user_name = #{userName}
and #{startDate} <= DATE_FORMAT(mws.submit_day,'%Y-%m-%d') and #{endDate} >= DATE_FORMAT(mws.submit_day, '%Y-%m-%d')
GROUP BY mws.product_seq UNION ALL SELECT mws.product_seq, mp.product_name, mp.product_code, IFNULL(sum(check_pass_num), 0) as total_pass_num, IFNULL(sum(check_ng_num),0) as total_ng_num FROM micro_work_submit mws INNER JOIN micro_product mp on mws.product_seq = mp.product_seq and mws.tenant_code = mp.tenant_code INNER JOIN micro_user mu on mu.id = mws.submit_user
submit_type = '1' and submit_status = 0
and (mp.product_code like concat('%', #{productNameOrCode}, '%') or mp.product_name like concat( '%', #{productNameOrCode}, '%'))
and mu.user_name = #{userName}
and #{startDate} <= DATE_FORMAT(mws.submit_day,'%Y-%m-%d') and #{endDate} >= DATE_FORMAT(mws.submit_day, '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT IFNULL(sum(a.total_num), 0) as total_num, a.user_name as user_name, a.nick_name as nick_name FROM ( SELECT IFNULL(sum(mws.check_pass_num), 0) + IFNULL(sum(mws.check_ng_num), 0) as total_num, mu.user_name, mu.nick_name FROM micro_work_submit mws INNER JOIN micro_user mu on mu.id = mws.submit_user

mws.submit_type = '1' and mws.submit_status in (1, 2)
and mu.nick_name like concat('%', #{submitNickName}, '%')
and #{startDate} <= DATE_FORMAT(mws.submit_day, '%Y-%m-%d') and #{endDate} >= DATE_FORMAT(mws.submit_day, '%Y-%m-%d')
